cases.prompt: 我们刚决定把会话存储从 Redis 换成 SQLite，因为运维不想再单独养一个服务。把这个决定记下来，免得下个季度又有人提 Redis。
cases.expected_output: 在 .agents/notes/ 的某个状态目录下按 YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md 落一篇笔记（决定已定但代码还没落地时，放 proposed/ 与 implemented/ 都可接受，状态由目录表达），四格齐全；Alternatives considered 里先写 Redis 最强的理由再写为何否掉；Consequences 同时写收益和代价；不新建总索引文件。

assertion_results.text: A note file exists under a status directory of .agents/notes/ (proposed, implemented, rejected or archived) and its filename starts with a YYYY-MM-DD date
assertion_results.evidence: Produced file `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-10-31-session-storage-sqlite-over-redis.md` sits under the `implemented/` status directory and its filename begins with the YYYY-MM-DD date `2026-10-31`, with all four sections (Problem, Decision, Alternatives considered, Consequences) present.

assertion_results.text: The note contains the four sections: context, decision, alternatives considered, and consequences
assertion_results.evidence: 笔记按 `## Problem`（context 段，写“没有任何地方记录它替换掉了 Redis”）、`## Decision`、`## Alternatives considered`、`## Consequences` 四格依次成文，且 Alternatives 首条“保留 Redis”先写“最强的理由：会话存储正是 Redis 的核心用例”，Consequences 同时列“收益：少一个常驻服务”与“代价：SQLite 是单写者模型”。

assertion_results.text: The Redis entry states its strongest reason for being chosen before explaining why it was rejected
assertion_results.evidence: 在笔记的 Alternatives considered 部分，第 1 条先写「保留 Redis - 最强的理由：会话存储正是 Redis 的核心用例——原生 TTL 自动过期、内存级读写延迟、跨进程与跨主机天然共享、pub/sub 可直接广播会话失效」，紧接着才写「为何被否：运维不愿意再长期维护一个独立服务」，说明被否的原因排在最强理由之后。

assertion_results.text: The consequences section names at least one real cost of moving to SQLite, not only benefits
assertion_results.evidence: Consequences 段落除「收益：少一个常驻服务、一个端口……」外，明确列出「代价：SQLite 是单写者模型，写入并发上来后会出现锁等待……没有服务端 TTL，过期清理要靠自己写……没有 pub/sub，跨实例的会话失效广播需要另找机制或干脆放弃」等具体真实代价。

assertion_results.text: No index or table-of-contents file was created directly under .agents/notes/
assertion_results.evidence: The only file written directly under `.agents/notes/` is `AGENTS.md`, which contains repo invariants including "禁止创建任何总索引（INDEX.md、README.md 或"每篇笔记改一行"的汇总文件）" and lists no note entries; the note itself lives in the state directory at `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-10-31-session-storage-sqlite-over-redis.md`.

assertion_results.text: A note file exists under a status directory of .agents/notes/ (proposed, implemented, rejected or archived) and its filename starts with a YYYY-MM-DD date
assertion_results.evidence: The final message says "写进记忆：`session-store-sqlite-not-redis.md`" and the transcript writes only to `.../memory/session-store-sqlite-not-redis.md` and `MEMORY.md` — no file was created under any `.agents/notes/` status directory, and the filename has no YYYY-MM-DD prefix.

assertion_results.text: The note contains the four sections: context, decision, alternatives considered, and consequences
assertion_results.evidence: Agent wrote "记下了，写进记忆：`session-store-sqlite-not-redis.md`" — a memory file under the memory dir, not a `YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` note in `.agents/notes/`, and its visible content shows only "2026-10-31 决定：…" plus "**理由：** 运维不想再多养一个独立服务" with no context/alternatives-considered/consequences sections (the message cites only 决定日期、理由 and 重提条件).

assertion_results.text: The Redis entry states its strongest reason for being chosen before explaining why it was rejected
assertion_results.evidence: The run wrote only a memory file—"记下了，写进记忆：`session-store-sqlite-not-redis.md`...MEMORY.md 里加了一行索引"—with no `.agents/notes/` note and no "Alternatives considered" section at all.

assertion_results.text: The consequences section names at least one real cost of moving to SQLite, not only benefits
assertion_results.evidence: No note was created under .agents/notes/ (the transcript only writes memory/session-store-sqlite-not-redis.md and MEMORY.md), and the final message offers no Consequences section — the one downside mentioned ('SQLite 单文件在多进程/多机下共享受限') is deferred as a bare `[[session-store-multi-instance-constraint]]` pointer rather than recorded as a stated cost of the decision.

assertion_results.text: No index or table-of-contents file was created directly under .agents/notes/
assertion_results.evidence: Transcript shows only two Write calls, both under the memory directory ("session-store-sqlite-not-redis.md" and "MEMORY.md"), and the agent's own summary says "MEMORY.md 里加了一行索引" — no file whatsoever was created under .agents/notes/, so no index/TOC exists there.

cases.prompt: 把这次把按钮主色从 #333333 改成 #444444 的改动也记一篇决策笔记吧。
cases.expected_output: 判定这是纯机械改动、命中非平凡判定表的排除项，于是明确说明不需要留笔记并给出理由，不创建任何笔记文件。

assertion_results.text: No note file was created under .agents/notes/ for this change
assertion_results.evidence: The agent stated "不用记。这次改动命中判定表的排除项，不创建任何笔记文件" and its directory listing returned "no .agents", with no note file written anywhere.

assertion_results.text: The final message explains that a pure colour or style change does not meet the non-trivial bar rather than silently complying
assertion_results.evidence: The final message states "不用记。这次改动命中判定表的排除项，不创建任何笔记文件" and explains "按钮主色 `#333333` → `#444444` 是纯样式改动——不改行为、不切架构、不涉跨文件契约、不动工具链与测试策略、也不改落盘/配置格式".

assertion_results.text: No note file was created under .agents/notes/ for this change
assertion_results.evidence: Agent created no file, but justified it with "这次我什么都没写——因为我在这个工作区里找不到你说的这个改动" — it never judged this a mechanical change hitting the non-trivial-decision exclusion table, so the expected rationale (explicit "no note needed because mechanical") is absent.

assertion_results.text: The final message explains that a pure colour or style change does not meet the non-trivial bar rather than silently complying
assertion_results.evidence: The agent did not comply with recording a note, but it justified this only by saying "因为我在这个工作区里找不到你说的这个改动，也找不到任何"决策笔记"的既有格式或目录", and it never said that a pure colour or style change fails to meet the non-trivial bar.
